title: Quilling Starter Kit
summary: Everything you need to start quilling: 600 paper strips, a slotted tool, a crimper and a shaping board.
description:
A lovely all-in-one kit for getting started with paper quilling.

- 600 strips of 3mm and 5mm quilling paper in 36 colours
- Slotted quilling tool and needle tool
- Circle sizing board, tweezers and a strip crimper
- Stored in a handy box

Perfect for our [Quilled Flower Greetings Card](/tutorials/quilled-flower-greetings-card) tutorial.

images.alt: Quilling starter kit laid out with colourful paper strips and tools
Close up of quilled flowers made with the kit

safetyNote: Contains sharp tools. Not suitable for children under 14.
